items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: And Dave on drum and me on trumpet

ctx.x: And who did he have in his band?

Well they had, I don't know what this tipping guy name on trombone, there's a tip when he wore, a dark fella. And Dave on drum and me on trumpet, well he was different clarinet players. You never had the same clarinet players, you know. George Boyd played with us a while. What's the name, Little Pill? Cripple Pill. Yeah. Let's see, did they have a guitar at the band?
A banjo? Yeah, a banjo. You know the banjo play out there, I forget.
